'''Mim''' was one of the two [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. It was rocky and airless. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] occasionally used it for training in low-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] environments.<ref name="geo" />
